requirement: External GIMAC network status must never directly mutate balances.
Represent initiation, accepted, pending, rejected, unknown, cleared, settled, reversed and disputed with separate provenance.
Persist immutable idempotency identity and network correlation keys; never retry unknown financial outcomes as fresh payments.
Use independently verified settlement evidence before marking settlement final.
Reconcile network transaction, clearing, settlement, nostro and GL records with exception queues.
Require risk-based authorization, limits, AML/sanctions screening and maker-checker where applicable.
Isolate network credentials, certificates and keys; log privileged actions without sensitive payload leakage.
Support QR, bank-wallet, wallet-bank, card and merchant capabilities only after each scheme contract is authenticated.
Version and effective-date fee, dispute, settlement and message rules per participating institution.
Do not claim certified or connected until GIMAC issues evidence of completed approval and testing.
